subject: PO instructions, invoice cadence and credit terms — BlueOak Health
messages:
From: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@blueoakhealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO instructions, invoice cadence and credit terms

Hi Vanessa,

Quick procurement question as we prep our PO for Redwood. A few items we need to confirm before routing internally:

- Can Redwood accept a consolidated monthly invoice that aggregates spend by BU (we need a single invoice per month with line items mapped to our cost centers)?
- PO content: we need the vendor to accept a PO that references our subscription SKU(s), includes our internal cost center codes, and lists Redwood's EIN and remittance address. Can you provide a vendor PO template or required PO fields?
- Net payment terms: our standard is net60. Will Redwood accept net60 for an enterprise agreement, or do you have a required credit-review process?
- Early-pay/settlement discounts: do you offer any discount for faster payment (net15/net30) or for multi-year commitments?

If you can send a short summary and any templates, that would help accelerate approvals on our side.

Thanks,
Elaine Kim
Procurement Manager
BlueOak Health
procurement@blueoakhealth.com

[Attachment: PO_Routing_Guidelines.pdf (stub)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@blueoakhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO instructions, invoice cadence and credit terms

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then details below:

- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we can produce a single monthly invoice that breaks out line items by cost center (we map to your cost center codes if provided).
- PO fields: we accept POs referencing subscription SKUs; required fields are: PO number, billing address, remittance address, cost center code mapping, and a reference to the signed Master Subscription Agreement (MSA) or purchase order date. I attached our PO template for your AP team.
- Net terms: standard for self-serve customers is net30. For enterprise agreements we can consider net45 or net60 subject to a credit review and signed amendment.
- Discounts: we do offer structured discounts for annual or multi-year commitments and occasional early-pay credits. For example, for annual prepay we provide tiered discounts; for net15/net30 we can explore a 1–3% early-payment credit depending on ARR.

Proposed next steps to keep things moving:
1) Send your PO draft with cost center mappings to me and we’ll validate the line items.
2) If you require net60, please indicate that on the PO and we’ll initiate a credit check (typical turnaround 3–5 business days).
3) I’ll loop in finance and legal for any amendment needed; Kar thik (cc’d) can help map SKUs and expected usage so invoices align to your internal coding.

I attached: PO_Template_Redwood.csv and our standard W-9.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your AP if helpful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Office: (415) 555-0123

[Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.csv (stub), Redwood_W9.pdf (stub)]

From: procurement@blueoakhealth.com <procurement@blueoakhealth.com>

Cc: Elaine Kim <elaine.kim@blueoakhealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO instructions, invoice cadence and credit terms

Vanessa — quick follow from our AP team after reviewing the template. A couple of constraints on our side:

- Our corporate policy defaults to net60 for SaaS vendors. We can entertain net45 in rare cases but need justification.
- Because we operate with multiple business units, we need consolidated monthly invoices with each line item tagged to a cost center and an invoice-level summary for payment batching.
- For supplier discounts: given the size of our expected first-year commitment, we are asking for a 5% pricing concession if Redwood will accept net60. If you’re able to offer any additional concessions for multi-year (2 yr) commitment we can include that in the PO.

Please let us know whether net60 + 5% concession is in scope or if there is a middle ground we should propose to procurement.

Thanks,
BlueOak Procurement Team
procurement@blueoakhealth.com

Requested: quick response today so we can give BlueOak a clear path.

Vanessa

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueOak PO / net60 / 5% discount request — need approvals

Vanessa — thanks for the heads-up. Finance perspective below: 

- Net60: We can approve net60 for enterprise customers after a standard credit review. For new customers, credit review typically requires 3–5 business days and we require the signed MSA plus PO before enabling net60 terms. We also require a billing contact and AP contact on the PO for remittance issues.

- Discounts: Our delegated authority allows Finance to approve up to 3% on pricing for accounts under $250k ARR. Anything over 3% requires Sales Director sign-off and >5% requires VP approval. Given your ARR estimate (~$140k), we can approve up to 3% without Director involvement.

- Compromise recommendation: offer BlueOak net60 with a 2% price concession (instead of 5%) plus a condition that invoices are consolidated monthly with cost-center line items. If BlueOak is willing to convert to annual prepay or a 2-year commitment, we can revisit a larger discount.

- Contract/legal: Marissa — please advise on amendment language. We should add a short amendment that references the PO and documents net60 payment terms, billing address, and cost-center mapping, and includes a clause requiring W-9 and remittance details. Also recommend a late-payment SLA (1.5% monthly) to protect cash flow.

I attached a short note documenting the approval path and required evidence.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Finance_approval_note.docx (stub)]

Hi Elaine — thanks for your patience while we ran this through finance and legal. Good news and next steps below.

What we can offer today:
- Redwood will accept net60 for BlueOak Health contingent on a standard credit review and a signed amendment referencing net60. Credit reviews take 3–5 business days once we receive the PO and signed MSA.
- In lieu of the 5% concession requested, Redwood can provide a 2% pricing concession for year one if BlueOak accepts net60 and consolidated monthly invoices with cost-center line items.
- If BlueOak is able to commit to annual prepay or a 2-year agreement we will consider a larger concession; happy to discuss numbers if you have a target.

Please provide:
1) A draft PO (including cost center codes and AP contact) — use the attached PO_Template_Redwood.csv as a guide.
2) Signed MSA or an instruction to sign the attached amendment (DocuSign link below).
3) W-9 and remittance instructions for your AP team.

I’ve attached the PO template and W-9 again and included a DocuSign link for the amendment that documents net60. Once we receive the PO and the signed amendment we’ll start the credit review and target enabling net60 within 3–5 business days.
